title: blueprint-foreman fire
description: The fire as Specification v1 gives it: one JSON object, the text a routine is fired with, which the session hands verbatim to the engine's `wake` on stdin. The engine validates every fire against this file with its own code. A fire whose key or branches it cannot read writes nothing; any other it refuses is signalled `failed` on the agent's branch.

specification.description: The version of the specification the fire follows.

key.description: The work item's key: a capital letter, then capital letters or digits, a hyphen and digits, as `PROJ-1`.

title.description: The work item's title, for people.

branch.description: Blueprint's branch for the item, B, as origin names it without `refs/heads/`. One or more segments joined by `/`, each of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter, a digit or `_`, ending with neither `.` nor `.lock`, with no `..` anywhere; not under `claude/`.

agentBranch.description: The agent's branch, F: `claude/` and B's name. The run works only here, cutting it from B's tip where origin does not have it, else continuing it.

pullRequest.description: The item's pull request, from B to the default branch, which Blueprint opened; for people.

design.description: Where the design is: `<docsRoot>/<KEY>/blueprint.md`, relative to the repository's root.

signal.description: The git trailer key under which the agent signals its state on F.

answer.description: A person's reply to the run's last `needs-human`, or null.

options.description: The harness's own options for this agent, which Blueprint passes through untouched. A run takes them at admission and keeps them: a later fire's are ignored.

practices.description: The practices the run holds, each true (on) or false (off). A practice not named is on. Turning one off never loosens what every run holds: admission, the scaffold's lock and gaps, convergence with the design, and the run's own record.

slices.description: The run plans the work as slices, each realizing some of the design's scenarios, and the plan gate attacks the plan. Off: the plan holds one slice, which realizes every scenario, and no plan gate attacks it.

red-green.description: Each slice's tests are written first and must fail on an assertion (red), then a separate subagent's code makes them pass (green). Off: one Builder per slice writes the code and its tests, and the tests must pass.

mutant.description: After green, a fresh subagent that has not read the tests names one small edit to the code, and the slice's tests must fail on it. Off: no mutant.

review.description: Before a slice lands, Reviewers review its diff in groups and a Contract Reviewer judges it against the design's scenarios. Off: no Reviewers and no Contract Reviewers; a slice lands once its replays pass, and the description says no scenario was reviewed.

adversary.description: The Adversary, a model of another family, attacks the plan at the plan gate and the finished change at the final gate. Off: no Adversary and no plan gate; the final gate still holds the engine's own findings, and the Contract Reviewer's where review is on.

exhibits.description: Each slice promises an exhibit its proof run writes, something a person who was not in the session can look at, and the description links them. Off: no promise and no Exhibits section.

lessons.description: At settle, what the run taught lands in one commit in the repository's lesson homes. Off: no lessons commit.

models.description: A model per role, over the harness's settings.

broad.description: Red, Green and the Builder on a broad slice.

contained.description: Red, Green and the Builder on a contained slice.

reviewer.description: The Mutant, the Reviewers and the Contract Reviewer.

adversary-fallback.description: The Claude subagent that stands in for the Adversary.

adversary.description: The Adversary, over the harness's settings.

zeroDataRetention.description: Whether its requests may reach only zero-data-retention endpoints; on unless false.
